title: Data and code for "Environmental heterogeneity and the diversity of Neotropical frugivorous bats"
description: Curation pipeline, derived data tables and analysis code for a study of taxonomic and phylogenetic alpha and beta diversity of four frugivorous phyllostomid genera (Artibeus, including Dermanura; Carollia; Platyrrhinus; Sturnira), with Anoura as a secondary contrast, against present topographic heterogeneity and historical climatic instability, in equal-area cells of 50, 100 and 200 km across the Neotropics.
